# Levente Varga

> Portfolio of Levente Varga, full stack developer and entrepreneur from Debrecen, Hungary. Founder of PandaSoft, Panda3D and Dotrix, and IT engineering student at the University of Debrecen. Builds modern web applications with Node.js and React, plus the CI/CD pipelines and container infrastructure (Docker, Podman, Kubernetes) that keep them secure and stable.

Languages: Java, C#, Python, PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript. Available for freelance work.

## Pages

- [Home](https://varga-levente.com/): Introduction, selected projects, services, experience, work process and contact
- [About](https://varga-levente.com/about): Background, tech stack, tools and GitHub activity
- [Projects](https://varga-levente.com/project): All projects with source code and demo links

## Experience

- Founder of PandaSoft, Panda3D and Dotrix (now)
- IT engineering student, University of Debrecen, Faculty of Informatics (now)
- .NET developer, R&D, National Instruments (Emerson) (past)
- PHP backend developer, PQRS Kft. (past)

## Services

- Web development: React, Next.js, TypeScript
- Backend and APIs: Node.js, Flask
- DevOps: Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, Nginx
- Mobile and IoT: Android, Java, ESP32, Raspberry Pi

## Projects

- [PandaSoft](https://pandasoft.hu/): Software development business: custom software, web development and IT consulting
- [Panda3D](https://panda3d.hu/): 3D printing business: custom prints, prototyping and other 3D printing services
- [Dotrix](https://dotrix.app/): Discord bot
- [Cinema app](https://github.com/Varga-Levente/Szoftverfejlesztes-mernokoknek): Movie tickets with seat selection and snack pre-orders (React, Java Spring, MySQL)
- [RoBOT Android app](https://github.com/Varga-Levente/RoBOT-Controller-Android-APP): Controls an ESP32 robot over TCP/IP (Android, Java, ESP32)
- [Real-time chat](https://github.com/Varga-Levente/Tavkozlohalo-Chat): Chat client, server and Python validation API with file transfer (C#, Python, TCP/IP)
- [1-bit BMP graph generator](https://github.com/Varga-Levente/rendszerkozeli-programozas-projekt): C program drawing 1-bit BMP graphs over IPC
- [GTA V roleplay gym site](https://github.com/Varga-Levente/NFGym-Website): Sales and attendance logging for a roleplay server gym (PHP, MySQL)
- [Education page](https://edu.vlevente.me/): Framework-free PHP site with university course notes
